name: motif_change_affix_kind
description:
Change an affix’s kind. Research first: motif_guide topic suffix-prefix-slots; check best practice. Use only if the evidence, such as paradigms or a category change, now decides inflectional or derivational; otherwise keep the kind. Unclassified is a stopgap that lets the parser find wrong parses (guide suffix-prefix-slots). Stages a change of one affix between inflectional, derivational and unclassified in place, keeping its category and the senses that use it. What the new kind cannot hold, such as a template slot or a To category, is reported as a warning, not refused. Dry Run and Trial before a person Applies the Proposal.
Command: compose-change-affix-kind. Agent class: Draft.

msa.description: Id of the affix’s current grammatical info.

kind.description: New kind: inflectional, derivational or unclassified.

to_category.description: For derivational only: id of the category of the word it makes; the attaching category when absent.

slots.description: For inflectional only: ids of the existing slots it fills.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
